project_type: Rust multi-crate workspace - deterministic-first autonomous execution framework
build_system: Cargo workspace with resolver=2, workspace.dependencies pattern
test_framework: cargo test with inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests, some doc-tests. No external test harness. Tests use tempfile for temp dirs, pearl_core::TestClock for deterministic time.
verification_instructions: 1. cargo fmt --all --check 2. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings 3. cargo test --workspace 4. cargo build -p pearl-cli && ./target/debug/pearl constitution check capabilities/
setup_instructions: Rust 1.92.0 pre-installed. cargo build --workspace compiles everything. No external deps beyond cargo (rusqlite is bundled).
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available. Network access for crates.io (COMMON_DEPENDENCIES mode). All validation is host-based via cargo.
contribution_requirements: All new crates added to workspace members in /projects/sandbox/pearl/Cargo.toml. workspace.dependencies used for shared deps. Constitution gate (pearl constitution check capabilities/) must pass. Clippy -D warnings clean. cargo fmt clean. Every crate has doc comment on lib.rs explaining its Constitution article enforcement.
key_patterns: 1. Each crate lib.rs has module-level doc explaining Constitution articles enforced. 2. pearl-core owns data models (no I/O), other crates own behavior. 3. Events are source of truth (ADR-0001), materialized tables are derived. 4. PearlEvent enum in pearl-events is the closed vocabulary. 5. Governance manifests are YAML with CapabilityManifest struct. 6. Process supervisor uses Unix process groups (setsid). 7. Clock trait for testable time. 8. IDs use UUIDv7 via pearl_core::ids. 9. Errors use thiserror. 10. Serde with rename_all for all enums.
directory_structure: pearl/ - workspace root. crates/ - library crates (pearl-core, pearl-events, pearl-state, pearl-lease, pearl-queue, pearl-process-supervisor, pearl-governance). apps/ - binary crates (pearl-cli). capabilities/ - example YAML manifests (guards/, scripts/, verifiers/). schemas/ - JSON schema files. docs/ - system-analysis.md.
